parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id,
  element_type,
  severity,
  quoted_text,
  issue_description,
  editor_suggestion,
  status
FROM manuscript_issues
WHERE manuscript_id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.manuscriptId }}'
  AND chapter_number = {{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.chapterNumber }}
  AND phase_number = 3
  AND status != 'dismissed'
ORDER BY created_at;
UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'received', received_at = NOW() WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status

Your responses should:

Encourage improvement while acknowledging challenges

Explain what's technically incorrect
Provide the correct form
Cite the relevant rule or guideline
Offer mnemonic devices or memory aids when helpful

UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'failed', completed_at = NOW(), terminal_reason = $2 WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
